question: What opposing categories of sin and merit are cited as irrelevant to the realized yogin?
premises: Sins such as the killing of a brahman are mentioned.
Merits such as the fruit of the horse sacrifice are mentioned.
inference: Both grave sins and great ritual merits are brought into the same frame of irrelevance.
plain_english: Sins such as the killing of a brahman, and fruits such as those of the horse sacrifice and others.
